run_filter_openhermes_dataset: run the script to filter the OpenHermes-2.5 dataset by language, category, and source then push to hub
create_filter_by_category_and_source: create a filter function that excludes dataset entries by category and source blacklist
extract_prompt_from_conversations: extract the first human-gpt prompt pair from a conversations list in a dataset entry
filter_dataset_by_language: filter a HuggingFace dataset to keep only English or null language entries
push_filtered_dataset_to_hub: push a filtered and mapped dataset to the HuggingFace Hub under a new repository name
